newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: INSIGHT-Australian 10-yr bond testing the trend.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Australian 10-yr bond testing the trend.

text.p: Australian bond futures extended Tuesday's consolidative sell-off in after-hours trading as U.S. Treasuries also posted a modest correction.
The September 10-year bond futures contract ended SYCOM at 92.900, down from Tuesday's 92.925 pit close and having dipped to 92.875 at one stage.

The month's steep rising trendline, and last leg of the rally from 91.700 in April, is being put under pressure at 92.880, and the market needs to close above this level to maintain the bullish trend, analysts said.
The 10-year bond, through the now-expired June contract, touched a 3-1/4 year high on Monday of 93.090.
The corrective pullback across the curve has brought the market back from its extreme overbought levels of over 80 percent on relative strength indices to just under 75 percent.
Local data for Wednesday remains thin with only Westpac's leading index for April due for release, leaving the market vulnerable to movements in offshore markets.
The easier tone in the U.S. ended a three-day run of price gains with a benign CPI report for May having been largely built in after the rally which followed Friday's weak PPI.
